removed_from_account.reason: operator: the 4 trades of the retired debate rule (dual-ai 1.1.0, stopped in 1.2.0) are removed from the paper account; they stay in the journal

debate_pick_if_taken.note: on a disagreement (not traded), the side the shadow debate picked, followed forward as if taken, after costs: what standing aside skipped

debate_losing_side_if_taken.note: the side the debate rejected, followed forward as if taken, after costs: if it does better than the side picked, the debate is choosing the wrong side

trader2_levels_in_shadow.note: since dual-ai 1.10.0 a trade is on Trader 1's levels; the same agreement on Trader 2's own levels, followed forward and never traded. difference_r > 0 would mean Trader 2's levels did better

low_confidence_in_shadow.note: since dual-ai 1.12.0 an agreement is a trade only when both traders state 65 or more; the agreements below, followed forward as the trades they would have been, after costs. Doing better than the trades taken would mean the floor costs money

senior_vetoes_in_shadow.note: since dual-ai 1.18.0 a trade both traders agree on is taken only with the senior trader's approval; the ones it did not approve (vetoed, or no usable answer), followed forward as the trades they would have been, after costs. Doing better than the trades taken would mean its vetoes cost money

exits_in_shadow.note: each trade taken, followed again under another exit on the same entry, after costs; difference_r > 0 means that exit would have done better on these trades. Measured, never traded
